name: Player-prop minutes model (PPMM)
signal: Prop lines are minutes-driven; a minutes-floor projection plus a negative-binomial count model prices them, and combo legs inherit the minutes correlation.

thresholds.inputs: BLOCKED: player box scores, official minutes, prop lines

universe: player props on games in the T+0..T+3 window, once a prop line exists
settlement_rule: Official NBA final box score per player (minutes, points, rebounds, assists). No prop line and no official minutes feed exist, so no bet is placed until gates G6 and G7 pass.
status: pre-registered, 0 bets placed, inputs BLOCKED (no prop line / no official minutes feed)
